name: Excel
requirementsDoc: Write and read Excel workbooks programmatically, cell by cell, with styling — an invoice, a statement, a report with several sheets, a filled template the finance team designed in Excel — over exceljs. Every function takes the workbook handle New Workbook or Open Workbook answers and gives it back; Workbook To Base64 and a Save File step turn it into a download.

functions.jsdoc: A workbook: a class, constructed with new. addWorksheet(name), getWorksheet(name), worksheets, eachSheet(fn), xlsx.load(bytes) and xlsx.writeBuffer() are its API.
